newsitem.title: USA: IVC Industries says to buy back shrs.
newsitem.headline: IVC Industries says to buy back shrs.

text.p: IVC Industries Inc said Tuesday its board of directors has authorized it to begin a repurchase program for up to 250,000 shares of its common stock.
The company said the purchases may be made from time to time in the open market and will be used for general corporate purposes.
The company said the timing, price and amount of the purchases will be influenced by various factors, including general market conditions and will be made at the discretion of management.
The company said it has 17,094,742 shares of common stock outstanding.
IVC makes and sells vitamins and nutritional supplements through drug stores, supermarkets and mass merchandising chains, as well as health food stores and independent drug stores.
